tasks.name: Backend image URLs
tasks.summary: Added development image URL fields to drama and collection responses, plus a development-only endpoint that serves .webp drama images from MEDIA_STORAGE_ROOT and rejects invalid paths and file types. Updated both API documents. Checks passed: back lint, 10 test files (31 tests), and build.

tasks.name: Frontend API contract
tasks.summary: Added home image URL fields, the public drama detail API type and fetch function, and URL handling for relative API images, absolute signed URLs, and null images while preserving static demo image resolution. Updated API contract tests, test registration, and README development setup guidance. Checks passed: front typecheck, test (17 tests), and export.

tasks.name: Home display
tasks.summary: Connected the featured, daily recommendation, and TOP 3 collections to the home screen, including API images, details, loading/empty/error states, UUID detail navigation, and disabled playback/save controls. Front typecheck, tests (17 passed), and export all passed.
